acceptanceCriteria: Measure the review receipt size against range size on representative large ranges and record the observed cap crossing.

If crossings are realistic, review emits a bounded affected summary (counts, plan digest, the equivalent `corvint affected --base` command) with an explicit omission unknown instead of refusing the whole review.
No summary claims a selection or gate absence that the full plan does not support; a maintained test covers an over-cap range.
body:
Filed 2026-10-06 by the orchestrator session.

Found by the V1-0865 lane (head 8c1a7d87). Since V1-0865, review --base embeds the full standalone affected receipt when the guidance inventory is incomplete. On PR 571 the review receipt grew from 6.2 KB to 149 KB. A large enough range pushes the affected section past the 1 MiB guidance output bound, and review then fails closed with `guidance output exceeds 1 MiB` instead of emitting a review. This is correct fail-closed behaviour but a usability limit on very large ranges.
title: review over a large range refuses with guidance output exceeds 1 MiB once the embedded affected receipt is large
